findings.title: Shell injection via ${{ inputs.* }} interpolation in deploy workflow
findings.impact: Reusable workflow inputs interpolated directly into run scripts can inject commands if a caller passes untrusted values.
findings.recommendation: Pass inputs via env: variables and reference them as shell variables.

findings.title: Third-party actions referenced by mutable tag instead of commit SHA
findings.impact: Mutable tags allow upstream tag retargeting to run unreviewed code in CI (supply chain).
findings.recommendation: Pin actions to full commit SHAs; let Renovate maintain them.

findings.title: Reusable workflows called with secrets: inherit
findings.impact: All repository secrets are exposed to the called workflow, violating least privilege.
findings.recommendation: Pass only the specific secrets required.

findings.title: OpenShift containers do not set allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
findings.impact: Processes in the containers may gain more privileges than the parent (setuid binaries).
findings.recommendation: Add allowPrivilegeEscalation: false to each container securityContext.

findings.title: Wildcard CORS enabled via BYPASS_CORS env flag
findings.impact: If the flag is mistakenly set in a deployed environment, any origin can call the API.
findings.recommendation: Disallow the flag when NODE_ENV is production, or remove it in favour of a dev proxy.

findings.title: Decoded JWT contents and JWKS URI written to logs
findings.impact: Token claims (user identifiers/email) may end up in logs if debug level is enabled.
findings.recommendation: Remove or redact token claim logging; use the structured logger only.

findings.title: Object.assign of parsed JSON into User object
findings.impact: Unvalidated JSON merged into an object; __proto__ own keys are not set by Object.assign on a normal object, so impact is limited to property overwrite.
findings.recommendation: Whitelist expected fields when hydrating User.

findings.title: multer 2.4.0: DoS via aborted request (CVE-2026-113872)
findings.impact: Denial of service of file-upload endpoints if multer is used at runtime.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade multer to the patched release.

findings.title: joi 18.3.0: DoS via inefficient regex (CVE-2026-118772)
findings.impact: ReDoS on validated input could exhaust CPU.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade joi to the patched release.

findings.title: basic-ftp 5.3.1 high-severity advisory (likely transitive/dev)
findings.impact: Reachability not established; likely build/test tooling dependency.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade via parent dependency or overrides.

findings.title: vite 8.3.0 with 6 moderate advisories (dev tooling)
findings.impact: Dev-server issues; exposure limited to developer machines/CI.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade vite to the latest patched version.

chapters.note: Monorepo with api, admin, public, db and libs components deployed through OpenShift manifests.
Workflows use mutable action tags, inherit all secrets and interpolate inputs into shell scripts.
Mapped findings: secrets inherit and privilege escalation breach least privilege; dependency highs relate to assume breach.
JWT verification pins RS256 and SECURITY_ENABLED defaults to true, so no algorithm confusion was found.
No manual review of route guards or RBAC was performed in this rapid pass.
Semgrep reported only a low-risk Object.assign pattern and workflow shell interpolation, no SQL injection hits.
CORS wildcard exists only behind an env flag; helmet and ValidationPipe are configured in bootstrap.
Encryption key fallback was removed and the service fails closed when the key is unset.
Gitleaks output was empty and no hardcoded default encryption key was found in the service source.
Debug logging of decoded token claims and a console.log of the JWKS URI were identified.
Code scanning alerts could not be read because the token lacked access (HTTP 403).
Secret scanning alerts could not be read because the token lacked access (HTTP 403).
Dependabot alerts could not be read because the token lacked access (HTTP 403).
OSV scanner and Trivy report high severity multer, joi and basic-ftp plus moderate vite advisories.
OpenShift deployment manifests omit allowPrivilegeEscalation false though runAsNonRoot is set.
Playwright e2e specs and API unit tests exist, including auth service tests toggling SECURITY_ENABLED.
Node engine range is current and renovate is configured, though pinned dependencies carry advisories.
